notes: Lease break: tenant moved out 3/28/23. Tenant paid all rent through March, the $3,300 lease-break fee to owner and the $1,000 re-renting fee. The claim covers only move-out damage, cleaning and landscaping. Landscaping invoice $435: $155 branch trimming marked owner ('O') and excluded by the PM. Jack'll Fix It $1,250 invoice: items marked O (smoke detectors, batteries, doorbell, dryer vent, fence etc.) excluded; tenant share $431.15. Tenant had pets (pet fees) but no pet damage is charged. The .msg shows a $1,341.90 card sale on 6/13/2023 under Contract 4571R, forwarded by Global Home USA to YRIG. It looks like a collection from the tenant after the claim, on the insurer side, so it is not recorded as a PM credit or settlement.
